title: Store 1 Delta Candidate
description: Schema for GovMem Store 1 delta candidate records. Candidates are review-only proposals for human/operator evaluation. store1_write_applied must always be false at generation time. Deltas are never applied automatically — a separate operator-approved patch tool is required.

artifact_type.description: Always 'store1_delta_candidate'. Identifies this as a candidate record, not an applied delta.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this candidate format.

store1_write_applied.description: Must always be false at generation time. Store 1 writes require a separate operator-approved patch tool.

candidate_only.description: Must always be true. Candidates are never applied automatically.

target_agent_id.description: ID of the agent this delta candidate is scoped to.

target_agent_role.description: Role of the target agent, or 'unknown'.

agent_scope.description: Always 'agent_local'. Agents cannot overwrite each other's Store 1.

shared_with_peer_agents.description: Must always be false. Store 1 is per-agent and not shared across agents.

shared_with_abigail.description: Whether this candidate is visible to Abigail for aggregation (not training).

abigail_training_eligible.description: Must always be false. Abigail training from any delta requires a separate governed path.

abigail_training_requires_approval.description: Abigail training always requires explicit operator approval, regardless of source.

source_store.description: Originating store. Always 'store_2' for generated candidates.

source_run_id.description: Run ID of the Store 2 batch this candidate was derived from.

source_record_id.description: Stable hash identifying the specific Store 2 source record.

sentinel_source.description: Provenance of the original detection. Determines whether operational actions may be recommended.

level.description: Severity level. D is highest risk.

memory_action_observed.description: Memory action recorded in the Store 2 source record.

sentinel_action_observed.description: Sentinel action recorded in the Store 2 source record.

haap_requirement_observed.description: HAAP requirement recorded in the Store 2 source record.

finding_type.description: Derived classification of the finding. simulation_evidence_only and legacy_analysis_only are always review-only.

recommended_store1_action.description: Recommended Store 1 action for operator consideration. review_only_no_promotion means no operational action is warranted.

recommended_memory_action.description: Recommended memory action if this candidate is approved.

recommended_sentinel_action.description: Recommended sentinel action if this candidate is approved.

recommended_haap_requirement.description: Recommended HAAP requirement if this candidate is approved.

rule_delta.description: Sanitized defensive signature delta. Review-only candidates carry a 'review_only|...' prefix and must not be applied.

audit_reason.description: Audit reason carried from the Store 2 source record.

operator_approval_required.description: Must always be true. No candidate may be promoted without operator approval.

approved_by_operator.description: Must be false at generation time. Set only by the separate operator-approved patch tool.

safety_status.description: Always 'candidate_only_not_applied' at generation time. Confirms no Store 1 write occurred.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of candidate generation.

source_file.description: Absolute path to the Store 2 JSONL file this candidate was derived from.
